children: Medartis Holding AG acquired the M.A.R.C. Institute in Doral, FL, creating its first U.S. surgical education center; the facility keeps its name and leadership, will remain open during planned modernization, and continues to serve third-party bookings.
Adds a strategic U.S. training hub, supporting product adoption and sales enablement in Medartis’ fastest-growing region.
Strengthens U.S. footprint and surgeon engagement, a key lever for implant system uptake.
Minimizes disruption to training pipeline and partner bookings.
Reduces integration risk and preserves customer relationships.
Sustains utilization and potential fee revenue; signals non-exclusive access.

This is a mid-cycle strategic move to deepen U.S. market access via surgeon training, aligning with Medartis’ education-led adoption model. A larger catalyst would be quantified impacts—utilization growth, surgeon conversion rates, or U.S. sales acceleration tied to the center.
